title: Premier Kaluga Hybrid Caviar
species: Kaluga hybrid ("River Beluga"): Kaluga × Amur sturgeon
flavor: mild, delicate and buttery, with a very mild, briny finish
store_description: With its generously sized grains and rich chocolate brown to dark amber color, Kaluga Hybrid (also known as The River Beluga) offers fantastic value for the price. It’s one of the most popular caviars in the world today, known for its consistency, versatility, mild flavor, and large, beautiful pearls. A hybrid of Amur River sturgeons Kaluga (Huso dauricus) and Japanese sturgeon (Acipenser schrenckii), this caviar delivers a delicate, buttery flavor with a very mild, briny finish. If you enjoy the firm texture and mild taste of Osetra, you’ll love this ecologically friendly, farm-raised caviar. Each jar is hand-packed to order and carefully inspected for optimal color, size, freshness, flavor, and texture.

title: American Hackleback Sturgeon Caviar
origin: Missouri and Mississippi river regions (Midwest), USA
flavor: mild and clean, with subtle earthy notes
store_description: Limited stock available due to the wild nature of the product and seasonality. Harvested from the fast-growing American sand sturgeon, American hackleback sturgeon caviar is a shining example of the richness found in the rivers of the Midwest. These fish are also regionally referred to as hackleback, shovelnose, or switchtail. Native to the Missouri and Mississippi River regions, the hackleback is the smallest of the sturgeon species, yet it yields a roe of remarkable character and quality. Hackleback caviar features small, glossy black pearls with glints of emerald and gold, which offer a striking appearance that hints at the elegance within. The texture is firm, resulting in a satisfying pop, while the flavor is beautifully mild and clean, with subtle earthy notes that make it endlessly versatile.
